title: Chaining Result with map & flatMap
hints: `Result` has `map` (transform success) and `flatMap` (chain another Result-returning step).
`parse(input).flatMap(validate).map { $0 * $0 }`, then switch once at the end.
jsBridge: Chaining `Result` with `map` and `flatMap` is railway-oriented programming: errors short-circuit, and success values flow on. It's like chaining `.then()` on Promises, but synchronous and with typed errors.

compass.q: Promise `.then` flattens automatically. Why does Swift need both `map` and `flatMap` on `Result`?
